archetype: TradingView Dark Professional / Pure Black High Density Terminal

typography.font_family_ui: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Trebuchet MS', Roboto, Ubuntu, sans-serif
typography.rules: All numerical data, prices, timers, percentages and volumes must use font-mono with tabular numbers (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

turkish_localization_rules.number_formatting: Thousands separator dot (.), decimal separator comma (,). E.g.: 73.258,01

elements: Brand logo 'EPOCHVERAS' with glowing epoch glyph
Symbol search modal trigger (e.g. BTCUSDT Perpetual Binance)
Candle style selector (Candles, Hollow, Heikin Ashi, Line)
Indicators dropdown (Epoch Script, RSI, EMA 20/50/200, MACD)

main_chart_area.canvas_rule: HTML5 Canvas or lightweight-charts with black background (#000000). Crosshair with dotted grey lines (#434651).

price_axis.price_tag: Current price label in green/red box based on last tick
price_axis.countdown_tag: Small pill showing candle close countdown directly under active price
price_axis.alarm_add_button: Hovering or tapping on price scale reveals small '+' badge to quickly set price alarm

indicators_pane.overlay: Epoch Script signals (trend cloud / entry markers / support-resistance bands)
indicators_pane.sub_pane: RSI (14) pane at bottom of chart with 70/30 dashed levels and purple curve

tabs.label: Alarmlar
features: Yeni alarm kur formu (Fiyat, Koşul, Not)
tabs.visual_rule: Chart only shows clean small tag pill at price coordinate; no disruptive horizontal line across the entire screen.

tabs.label: Vadeli Veriler
features: Fonlama Oranı (Funding Rate) ve sonraki ödeme sayacı (örn: 04:12:00)
Long/Short Hesap Oranı (Hesap bazlı Alıcı/Satıcı yüzdesi)
Top Trader Pozisyon Oranı (Balina / En İyi Yatırımcı Pozisyon Dağılımı)
Görselleştirme: Binance tarzı yeşil/kırmızı Alıcı-Satıcı çubukları (Buyer/Seller Bar, örn: %58.4 Long / %41.6 Short)
Açık Pozisyon (Open Interest) ve 24s Hacim Trendi

touch_and_pwa_guidelines.mobile_touch_targets: Minimum 40px touch targets for toolbar buttons on mobile/tablet
touch_and_pwa_guidelines.tablet_split_view: Collapsible sidebar that can slide over on mobile or dock as resizable pane on tablet/desktop
touch_and_pwa_guidelines.pinch_zoom_behavior: Chart handles two-finger pinch zoom and single finger pan seamlessly

login_page.inputs: Email and password inputs with Turkish labels (E-posta, Şifre, Giriş Yap, Kayıt Ol)
login_page.branding: Epochveras Terminal logo with animated glowing pulse

loading_state.logo_display: Prominent Epochveras geometric monogram with pulsing radial glow in pure black backdrop

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to Pure Black (#000000) for the main chart canvas and terminal backdrops as requested by the user.
Do not use generic gray backgrounds for the chart. The canvas must feel like TradingView pro terminal.
Ensure numbers are formatted in Turkish notation (e.g. 73.258,01 with dot for thousands and comma for decimal).
For the alarms, show only a compact marker badge/tag near the right price axis without spanning distracting lines across candles.
In the Futures Data panel, implement the dual-color ratio progress bar (green buyer / red seller) mimicking Binance Futures Long/Short ratios.
Implement the drawing tools logic (Trendline, Horizontal Ray, Long/Short Position Template, Soft Magnet toggle, Ruler) with active state styling.
Add responsive touch event support for tablet/mobile and ensure PWA manifest is present.
All interactive and informational UI components MUST carry data-testid attributes according to the defined conventions.
